platform: macOS arm64, native Retina GuavaUIDemo, Swift 6.4
method: CUA native accessibility actions, keyboard input and screenshots, plus real scene event-dispatch tests. Visual and functional verification; no latency measurements.
native_visual_verified: Gold whole and half stars, green read-only 4.25 rating and muted disabled 2.5 rating
Mini/small/regular/large SVG stars at 12/16/20/28 logical points and custom blue 36-point seven-star rating
All sizes and exact fractional filling inspected in light and dark themes
Whole, half and custom rating keyboard focus rings are visible
Gallery Disabled updates the interactive ratings, retaining the read-only examples
Independent Reset restores the custom rating from 7 to 3 and the half-star score to 2.5
native_keyboard_verified: Tab traversal reaches whole rating; Right changes 3 to 4
Tab traversal reaches half rating; Right changes 2.5 to 3
Half rating Home selects 0, End selects 5, Backspace clears and Right then selects 0.5
Tab skips the read-only average, disabled rating and four read-only density examples
Non-clearable custom rating Home selects 0.5; End selects 7 and Backspace preserves 7
native_accessibility_verified: Interactive ratings expose slider labels, numeric values and score help
A native accessibility value write changes Overall rating from 3 to 4 and updates the controlled readout
Read-only rating exposes image role and exact value 4.25; disabled ratings expose disabled state
automated_verified: Nine Rating tests cover independent group validation, non-finite inputs, density, intrinsic height and maximum counts
Real EventDispatcher pointer preview, complete click, a frame between press/release, repeat clear, drag back without clearing and outside cancellation
Half-star regions at an absolute padded origin, extreme coordinates, live binding replacement and external value change cancellation
Single Tab stop, half-step keyboard navigation, key-up exclusion, left/right modifier chords, Home/End/Delete/Escape
Accessibility snapping, invalid writes, non-clearable minimum and no actions for inactive controls
Configuration/disable/unmount cleanup releases capture and focus, removes handlers and permits node deallocation
Actual SVG decoding, partial-fill scissor bounds and focus-ring drawing
Additional gallery test dispatches a complete Rating click through nested scroll content, commits 4, then clears by repeated click

limitations: Full VoiceOver behavior has not been verified; CUA's focused UI element remains the window despite the working scene keyboard focus and visible focus ring

No GPUI quality or performance equivalence claim
native_pointer_verified: Coordinate click on fourth whole star changes the readout from 3 to 4; repeated click clears to 0
Pointer movement to second star shows two filled stars while controlled value remains 0; right-click does not commit
Drag from first to fifth star commits 5 on release inside
Drag from third star to outside cancels, retains 5 and restores the current score painting
Right half of third star selects 3; left half selects 2.5
Disabled and read-only ratings ignore native coordinate clicks
Continuous Slider drag changes 0.6 to approximately 0.1996 and finishes in Idle state

platform_input_fix.cause: SDL 3.4.18 on macOS 26+ replaced per-event mouse coordinates with a current global hardware query; Cocoa also reconciled explicit drag/button events against current hardware state and could insert premature releases.
platform_input_fix.fix: Pinned SDL Cocoa patch uses CGEvent location for the existing global coordinate compensation, reads button-event positions in absolute mode and preserves explicit button/drag event ordering. Relative mode and background-window position restoration are retained.
platform_input_fix.reproduction: Independent native SDL window: clicks (75,75) and (225,75), then drag (75,75) to (225,175); before/after JSON evidence in sdl-cocoa-input-native.json.
platform_input_fix.rebuild: CMake applies the tracked patch on macOS before building SDL. Fresh application, repeated configure and incompatible upstream rejection verified.
